description: JavaScript source code for TinyMCE advanced theme, including theme configuration, button definitions, command execution, and editor template generation.

classes.name: TinyMCE_AdvancedTheme
classes.description: Main object defining the advanced theme for TinyMCE, including button configurations, command handlers, and editor template generation.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for toolbar controls based on button name, including dropdowns, separators, and buttons.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes various editor commands such as help, link, image, color pickers, source editor, etc., handling UI interactions and content modifications.

methods.name: getEditorTemplate
methods.description: Builds the full editor HTML template with layout, toolbars, status bars, and resizable areas based on settings.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes a TinyMCE editor instance, including resizing and shortcut setup.

methods.name: removeInstance
methods.description: Removes theme-specific UI elements for a given editor instance.

methods.name: hideInstance
methods.description: Hides theme menus and overlays for a specific editor instance.

methods.name: _handleMenuEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse events on menu buttons, triggering commands.

methods.name: _hideMenus
methods.description: Hides all open theme menus for a given editor ID.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Updates toolbar button states based on the current selection or node in the editor.

methods.name: _setupCSSClasses
methods.description: Populates style dropdown with CSS classes from the editor content.

methods.name: _setCookie
methods.description: Sets a browser cookie with specified parameters.

methods.name: _getCookie
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie value by name.

methods.name: _resizeTo
methods.description: Resizes the editor iframe and container to specified width and height.

methods.name: _resizeEventHandler
methods.description: Handles mouse move events during resizing to adjust editor size dynamically.

methods.name: _setResizing
methods.description: Begins or ends the resizing process, showing resize handles and attaching event handlers.

methods.name: _getColorHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for color palette menu.

methods.name: _pickColor
methods.description: Opens color picker window or applies selected color.

methods.name: _insertImage
methods.description: Inserts an image tag into the editor content.

methods.name: _insertLink
methods.description: Inserts or updates a hyperlink in the editor content.
